$comment: Campaign level 22 (S4): a balloon archipelago on open sea. Home island west, rival island east with two Skylofts, two Watchtowers, posted guards and no lodges; six high isles between that only balloons reach. The Reliquary isle and the mist seer isle lie within 30 cells of the player Hearth, so the rival never floats worshippers there; the far south isle carries a ley stone and a strong storm ward side by side. Staged: raise a Skyloft (scripted in the bot scenario, the bot has no build objective handling), pray at the near Reliquary (teaches Whirlwind, wakes both ley isles), win the Gale Shrine before the rival balloons do (siteLost, the idle loss at about tick 14950), pray both ley isles and hold them, hold three isle stones for four minutes while raiders land on the north ley and pray it away, then the stones lift a causeway (it runs the short way round the world, over the west edge), unlock the lodges, send a rival war band over it and wake the Sky Gate isle mid sea, which the rival balloons race for (fromStage worship), then break the rival. Bot win about 28400.
name: The Cloud Isles
description: Isles float high over open sea and only balloons reach them. Raise a Skyloft, pray at the near Reliquary, beat the rival's balloons to the Gale Shrine, take both ley isles, hold three isle stones against sky raiders, then win the Sky Gate isle, cross the risen causeway and break the rival.

rewards.text: The sky Reliquary teaches Whirlwind. Two ley isles rise in the east, and the rival's balloons are stirring.
The Gale Shrine is yours: two Lightnings. Now take both ley isles from the rival.
The northern ley isle pays you mana while you hold it.
The southern ley isle pays you mana while you hold it.
The storm ward strikes any rival who lands beside it, at its own stone or the ley next to it.
The Sky Gate is yours: two Lightnings. Now cross the causeway and break the rival.
The mist seer watches the sea south of home.

objectives.text: Raise a Skyloft: only balloons reach the isles
Float two followers to the near isle and pray at the sky Reliquary
Pray at the Gale Shrine before the rival's balloons reach it
Pray both ley isles from the rival and hold them together for thirty seconds
Hold three isle stones at once for four minutes while the rival floats worshippers and raiders onto them
Float three followers to the Sky Gate isle mid sea and pray there before the rival balloons take it
Pass the rival Watchtowers, raze their Hearth and break the tribe

do.text: Raise a Skyloft. If the rival's balloons pray at the Gale Shrine first, the isles are theirs.
A ward rises beside the southern ley and a seer near home. Sky raiders land on the northern ley isle to pray it away.
The three stones lift a causeway out of the sea, and the rival marches over it. Beat them back, then win the Sky Gate isle that wakes mid sea.
The rival pulls its last guards back to the Hearth. Break the tribe.
